phases.name: Pre-Surgical Cardiac Prep
phases.clinical_note: Chlorhexidine wash, spirometer practice, sternal precaution review

advance_criteria.description: Spirometer training completed, baseline BP in range

meals.name: Lean Protein & Greens Lunch
meals.notes: Grilled salmon or tofu salad with olive oil

meals.name: Light Steamed Dinner
meals.notes: Steamed vegetables, lentils or chicken, whole grains

instructions: Deep diaphragmatic breathing: 10 breaths every 2 hours
Incentive spirometer practice: 10 reps per session

templates.focus_note: Prepare respiratory muscles and keep vitals stable prior to bypass surgery.

phases.name: Acute Sternal & Graft Healing
phases.clinical_note: Strict sternal precautions: no lifting > 5 lbs, support sternum when coughing

advance_criteria.description: Sternal stability maintained, no signs of wound infection

meals.name: Low-Sodium Recovery Breakfast
meals.notes: Poached eggs, avocado, whole wheat toast (< 300mg sodium)

meals.name: Tissue Repair Lunch
meals.notes: Lentil or grilled poultry bowl with steamed greens

meals.name: Cardioprotective Dinner
meals.notes: Baked fish, sweet potato, green beans

instructions: Strict sternal precautions: hug pillow when coughing
Incentive spirometry: 10 breaths every 2 hours while awake
Short assisted flat walks: 5-10 minutes, 2x daily

checks.name: Chest Sternal Wound & Leg Vein Harvest Site
checks.target: Clean, dry, no redness or drainage

checks.name: Daily Morning Weight
checks.target: Check for fluid retention (alert if +2 lbs in 24h)

templates.focus_note: Protect the sternal bone healing and monitor harvest incisions closely.

advance_criteria.description: Walking 25 mins without dyspnea or chest discomfort

meals.name: Fiber-Rich Heart Breakfast
meals.notes: Oat bran with chia seeds and almond milk

meals.name: Omega-3 Rich Dinner
meals.notes: Grilled trout or baked tempeh with asparagus

instructions: Gentle shoulder mobility and postural stretching
Avoid heavy push/pull or lifting > 10 lbs until 8 weeks post-op

templates.focus_note: Rebuild cardiac stamina and maintain strict heart-healthy dietary habits.
